rules.title: IVY PVE Server Rules
rules.description:
- This server is PVE only. If you want to practise your PVP skills, please find another server.
- No refund will be given for gear lost due to bugs without video evidence.
- Any form of bullying, harassment, abuse or toxic behaviour is not welcomed.
- Loot cycling (removing and dropping/destroying unwanted loot from spawn points to make space for new loot spawn) is strictly forbidden.
- Do not dupe, hack, glitch or cheat in any form to gain an unfair advantage.
- Use vehicles at your own risk. We do not refund any vehicles.
- Do not steal from other players. If it's not yours, don't take it.
- Please use English only in global chat.
- If you come across a bodybag, leave it for the owner to retrieve their possessions.
- Please make sure your in-game name and Discord name are the same.
- Ignorance is not bliss. Rule breaking will be dealt with accordingly.
